05/19.05.2023: Heard the parties.

The applicant, who is in custody since 02.06.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T. No.27 of 2023 arising out of Balumath P.S. Case No.87 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 498A, 304B and 34 IPC, pending in the court of Addl.
Sessions Judge-II, Latehar.
Earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant has been rejected vide order dated 06.02.2023 passed in B.A. No.10572 of 2022.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that some of the witnesses have been declared hostile.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been renewed.
On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the earlier rejection and the stage of the trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) stands rejected again.
However, trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same within six months from this order.
